purpose: POLGAPH development, stage 2: hourly candles of every listed market over its life (at most 35 days), for the overnight gap, the steady hour and the 7 day volume.
heldout: none: every market closes on or before 2026-11-12 23:59:59Z and no request ends after it; closes from 2026-11-13 are held out and not pulled
notes: Built by polgap/polgaph.py hourly-job from the lists answer; tickers and times only.

stop_rules.note: a 429 is waited out with a doubling pause and the same request is asked again; three in a row end the run; no other address, no proxy, no retry around a refusal
